# Pergola Building Permit

> Pergola Building Permit (part of GetMyPermit) prepares and lodges building permit applications for pergolas, patios, verandahs and decks in Perth and Western Australia.

## Pages

- [Pergola building permits in Perth, done for you.](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/): Need a pergola or patio building permit in Perth or WA? We check your council's rules, prepare the plans and engineering, and lodge it for you. Fixed price.
- [Do I need council approval for a pergola in WA?](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/do-i-need-council-approval-for-a-pergola): When a pergola needs a building permit in WA: roofed or open, attached or freestanding, plus the 10 m² rule and the planning rules that still apply.
- [Patio building permits in WA](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/patio-building-permit): Attached patios and verandahs need a building permit in WA. What's needed, the boundary rules, enclosing a patio, and how we prepare and lodge it for you.
- [Deck building permits in WA](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/deck-building-permit): Most decks in WA need a building permit, especially raised and attached decks. Privacy rules, balustrades, decks near pools, and how we handle the application.
- [Patio approval cost in Perth (2026)](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/patio-approval-cost-perth): A patio building permit in Perth usually costs about $183 in council fees and levies in 2026-27. Worked examples, BA1 vs BA2, planning fees and the other costs.
- [Guides](https://pergolabuildingpermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to pergolas, patios and decks approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
